shortDescription: Module for setup of SspInstance Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_client_cert
options.description: Client certificate that avi uses to authenticate with the ssp instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate that the ssp instance uses to authenticate with avi. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the onboarded ssp feature instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: feature
options.description: Type of the ssp feature instance. Enum options - SSP_INTELLIGENT_ASSIST, SSP_CENTRAL_LICENSING_SERVICE. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of the ssp feature instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ingress_cert
options.description: Ingress (server) certificate chain that the ssp endpoint uses. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the onboarded ssp feature instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: resources
options.description: Resources associated with the ssp feature instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: status
options.description: Status of the ssp feature instance. Enum options - SSP_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS, SSP_STATUS_ACTIVE, SSP_STATUS_CERT_UPDATE_FAILED. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant reference for the ssp object. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid for the onboarded ssp feature instance. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
